This indicates that estradiol may influence the activity of Ligandrol, which then affects Protein S100-A2. The scores from the paths are consistent, suggesting a plausible biological connection. The mechanisms are not fully elucidated, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct involvement of estradiol in the regulation of Protein S100-A2.
